ayat.text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
And complete the Hajj and 'Umrah for Allah.
and whoever fears Allah whoever has taqwa of Allah will make his matters easy and Allah will also make ways out for such a person who has taqwa
رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ
My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate us.
Complete your Hajj and Umrah for Allah
For whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves, then indeed Allah is free from need of the worlds.

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Umrah, Chapter: The Obligation of 'Umrah and Its Virtues, Hadith 1773
hadith.text: The performance of Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between one Umrah and the next, and the reward of Hajj Mabroor is nothing except Jannah

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan an-Nasa'i, Book of Jihad, Chapter: The One Who Fights Seeking Reward and Fame, Hadith 3140
hadith.text: A man came to Rasulullah and said: 'What do you think of a man who fights seeking reward and fame, what will he have?' Rasulullah said: 'He will not have anything.'

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Invocations, Chapter: The Seeking of Forgiveness by the Prophet Day and Night, Hadith 6307
hadith.text: Rasulullah, he also would ask Allah to forgive him 70 to 100 times a day

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Pilgrimage, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj Once in a Lifetime, Hadith 1337
hadith.text: O people, Allah has made Hajj an obligation for you, so perform Hajj

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj, Hadith 1721
hadith.text: Ibn Abbas said that he asked Rasulullah: 'Ya Rasulullah, Hajj is to be performed annually or only once?' Rasulullah said: 'Only once, and if anyone performs it more often, he performs a nafl'

hadith.expanded_reference: Musnad Ahmad, Musnad Bani Hashim, Hadith of Abdullah ibn Abbas, Hadith 2867
hadith.text: Hasten to do Hajj, for no one of you knows what will happen to him

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: Hastening the Performance of Hajj, Hadith 1732
hadith.text: Whoever intends to perform Hajj, let him hasten to do so, for he may fall sick, lose his mount, or be faced with some need.

hadith.expanded_reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi, Book on Hajj, Chapter: What Has Been Related About Combining Hajj and 'Umrah, Hadith 810
hadith.text: when we perform Hajj and Umrah, then what happens? We don't become poor, that's a Hadith

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: Combining Hajj and 'Umrah (Qiran), Hadith 1798
hadith.text: I came to Umar and said to him: I was a Christian Bedouin and I have embraced Islam. I am eager to do jihad, and I found that both Hajj and Umrah were due from me... Umar said: 'You have been guided to the practice of your Prophet.'

dua.text: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
اللَّهُمَّ ابْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَرِزْقِكَ.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ، فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ.

اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ

topics.name: Virtues of Hajj and Umrah
topics.description: Expiation of sins through Umrah and the guaranteed reward of Jannah for Hajj Mabroor.

topics.name: Sincerity in Worship (Ikhlas)
topics.description: Performing pilgrimage and religious actions purely for Allah without ostentation, pride, or worldly gain.

topics.name: Charity and Altruism (Sadaqah)
topics.description: Providing monetary charity, sharing meals, Zamzam, and guiding others during pilgrimage.

topics.name: Seeking Forgiveness (Istighfar & Tawbah)
topics.description: Humility before Allah, regular istighfar morning and evening, and reciting Sayyid al-Istighfar.

topics.name: Patience (Sabr) and God-Consciousness (Taqwa)
topics.description: Enduring pilgrimage hardships with steadfastness, avoiding disputes, and maintaining mindfulness of Allah.

topics.name: The Islamic Will (Al-Wasiyyah)
topics.description: Writing a formal legal will to settle debts and fulfill moral obligations prior to embarking on Hajj.

topics.name: Supplication in Islam (Ad-Du'a)
topics.description: Transforming personal life aspirations into heartfelt du'as and preparing a comprehensive du'a diary.

topics.name: Seeking Islamic Knowledge (Talab al-'Ilm)
topics.description: The religious requirement to learn authentic Hajj rituals according to the Sunnah before traveling.

topics.name: Obligation of Hajj (Fardiyyat al-Hajj)
topics.description: The Quranic status of Hajj as an essential pillar of Islam for those with physical and financial capacity.

topics.name: Hastening to Good Deeds (Al-Mubadarah ilal-Khayrat)
topics.description: Fulfilling the obligation of Hajj promptly once capable, without delay for worldly pursuits.
